meta.note: The push toward a real A2 vocabulary: the house, the body, clothing, the island outdoors, feelings, and the connective tissue — adjectives and adverbs frequent enough to appear in every second sentence.

cards.ex_t: O espelho da casa de banho está embaciado.
cards.ex_trans: The bathroom mirror is fogged up.

cards.note: toalha de mesa is a tablecloth
cards.ex_t: Leva uma toalha para a praia.
cards.ex_trans: Take a towel to the beach.

cards.note: sala de estar in full; sala de aula is a classroom
cards.ex_t: Estamos na sala a ver televisão.
cards.ex_trans: We're in the living room watching TV.

cards.ex_t: Esta almofada é dura demais.
cards.ex_trans: This pillow is too hard.

cards.ex_t: À noite é preciso cobertor, mesmo no verão.
cards.ex_trans: At night you need a blanket, even in summer.

cards.ex_t: Os copos estão no armário de cima.
cards.ex_trans: The glasses are in the top cupboard.

cards.note: usually plural: as escadas
cards.ex_t: O elevador avariou, vamos pelas escadas.
cards.ex_trans: The lift broke down, let's take the stairs.

cards.note: geladeira is the Brazilian word
cards.ex_t: Há sumo no frigorífico.
cards.ex_trans: There's juice in the fridge.

cards.ex_t: A sopa está no fogão.
cards.ex_trans: The soup is on the stove.

cards.note: ir para a cama = to go to bed
cards.ex_t: Vou para a cama, estou exausto.
cards.ex_trans: I'm going to bed, I'm exhausted.

cards.note: no chão = on the floor
cards.ex_t: Caiu tudo no chão.
cards.ex_trans: Everything fell on the floor.

cards.note: muro is the outdoor wall
cards.ex_t: Vou pendurar o quadro nesta parede.
cards.ex_trans: I'll hang the picture on this wall.

cards.ex_t: O telhado deixa entrar água quando chove muito.
cards.ex_trans: The roof lets water in when it rains a lot.

cards.note: half of Madeira's rent adverts lead with it
cards.ex_t: Tomamos o pequeno-almoço na varanda.
cards.ex_trans: We have breakfast on the balcony.

cards.note: tocar à campainha — to ring the bell
cards.ex_t: Toca à campainha, o portão está fechado.
cards.ex_trans: Ring the bell, the gate is closed.

cards.ex_t: Magoei o joelho na descida.
cards.ex_trans: I hurt my knee on the way down.

cards.note: plural olhos; olho! also means watch out
cards.ex_t: Ela tem os olhos verdes.
cards.ex_trans: She has green eyes.

cards.note: plural mãos; dar uma mão = to lend a hand
cards.ex_t: Dás-me uma mão com as compras?
cards.ex_trans: Can you give me a hand with the shopping?

cards.note: a pé = on foot; ao pé de = next to
cards.ex_t: Vou a pé, é perto.
cards.ex_trans: I'll walk, it's close.

cards.ex_t: Depois da levada, as pernas doem.
cards.ex_trans: After the levada, my legs ache.

cards.note: de braço dado = arm in arm
cards.ex_t: Parti o braço a jogar futebol.
cards.ex_trans: I broke my arm playing football.

cards.note: always plural — dói-me as costas
cards.ex_t: Tenho dores nas costas do computador.
cards.ex_trans: My back hurts from the computer.

cards.note: dor de garganta — the pharmacy phrase
cards.ex_t: Tenho a garganta inflamada.
cards.ex_trans: My throat is inflamed.

cards.ex_t: O exercício faz bem ao coração.
cards.ex_trans: Exercise is good for the heart.

cards.note: lavar os dentes — to brush your teeth
cards.ex_t: Tenho de marcar dentista, dói-me um dente.
cards.ex_trans: I need to book a dentist, a tooth hurts.

cards.note: camisola is a jumper, not a nightgown
cards.ex_t: Vou de camisa branca à reunião.
cards.ex_trans: I'm wearing a white shirt to the meeting.

cards.note: always plural, like in English
cards.ex_t: Estas calças ficam-te bem.
cards.ex_trans: These trousers suit you.

cards.note: the levada essential — weather turns fast
cards.ex_t: Leva casaco, lá em cima está frio.
cards.ex_trans: Take a jacket, it's cold up there.

cards.note: sapatilhas are trainers
cards.ex_t: Preciso de sapatos novos para o casamento.
cards.ex_trans: I need new shoes for the wedding.

cards.note: also the participle of vestir — dressed
cards.ex_t: Ela comprou um vestido para a festa.
cards.ex_trans: She bought a dress for the party.

cards.note: literally rain-guard; plural guarda-chuvas
cards.ex_t: Esqueci-me do guarda-chuva no autocarro.
cards.ex_trans: I forgot my umbrella on the bus.

cards.note: always plural; óculos de sol — sunglasses
cards.ex_t: Não vejo nada sem óculos.
cards.ex_trans: I can't see anything without glasses.

cards.ex_t: As montanhas da Madeira chegam aos 1800 metros.
cards.ex_trans: Madeira's mountains reach 1800 metres.

cards.note: à beira-mar = by the sea
cards.ex_t: Da varanda vê-se o mar.
cards.ex_trans: You can see the sea from the balcony.

cards.note: ondulação is the swell in forecasts
cards.ex_t: As ondas hoje estão grandes demais para nadar.
cards.ex_trans: The waves are too big to swim today.

cards.note: Madeira's are ribeiras — streams in ravines
cards.ex_t: O rio passa por baixo da ponte velha.
cards.ex_trans: The river runs under the old bridge.

cards.ex_t: Esta árvore dá boa sombra.
cards.ex_trans: This tree gives good shade.

cards.note: Festa da Flor — Funchal's flower festival
cards.ex_t: A Madeira está cheia de flores em maio.
cards.ex_trans: Madeira is full of flowers in May.

cards.ex_t: O céu está limpo, vai estar bom dia.
cards.ex_trans: The sky is clear, it'll be a nice day.

cards.ex_t: Cuidado com as pedras no trilho.
cards.ex_trans: Mind the stones on the trail.

cards.ex_t: A tempestade cancelou os voos.
cards.ex_trans: The storm cancelled the flights.

cards.note: plural arco-íris, unchanged
cards.ex_t: Depois da chuva apareceu um arco-íris sobre a baía.
cards.ex_trans: After the rain a rainbow appeared over the bay.

cards.ex_t: A cidade está cheia de turistas.
cards.ex_trans: The city is full of tourists.

cards.ex_t: Os meus sogros vivem numa aldeia no norte.
cards.ex_trans: My in-laws live in a village in the north.

cards.note: both the sidewalk and the walk you take on it
cards.ex_t: Vamos dar um passeio à beira-mar?
cards.ex_trans: Shall we take a stroll along the seafront?

cards.note: fazer ponte = to take a long weekend
cards.ex_t: Sexta é feriado — vou fazer ponte.
cards.ex_trans: Friday is a holiday — I'm taking the long weekend.

cards.note: the landmark directions are given by
cards.ex_t: A festa é no largo da igreja.
cards.ex_trans: The festival is in the church square.

cards.note: jardim de infância — kindergarten
cards.ex_t: Levo os miúdos ao jardim à tarde.
cards.ex_trans: I take the kids to the park in the afternoon.

cards.note: no centro = downtown; centro de saúde = health centre
cards.ex_t: Trabalho no centro, vou de autocarro.
cards.ex_trans: I work in the centre, I go by bus.

cards.note: a caminho de = on the way to
cards.ex_t: Compro pão a caminho de casa.
cards.ex_trans: I buy bread on the way home.

cards.note: orgulhoso de — proud of
cards.ex_t: Estou orgulhoso do teu português.
cards.ex_trans: I'm proud of your Portuguese.

cards.ex_t: Ficou triste com a notícia.
cards.ex_trans: He was saddened by the news.

cards.note: preocupado com — worried about
cards.ex_t: Estou preocupado com o prazo do visto.
cards.ex_trans: I'm worried about the visa deadline.

cards.ex_t: Fiquei surpreendido com o preço.
cards.ex_trans: I was surprised by the price.

cards.note: zangar-se com alguém — to get cross with someone
cards.ex_t: Ela está zangada comigo por causa do atraso.
cards.ex_trans: She's angry with me because of the delay.

cards.ex_t: Fico nervoso antes de falar português ao telefone.
cards.ex_trans: I get nervous before speaking Portuguese on the phone.

cards.note: estar com fome / ter fome — hunger is had, not been
cards.ex_t: Estou com uma fome terrível.
cards.ex_trans: I'm terribly hungry.

cards.note: same pattern: estar com sede / ter sede
cards.ex_t: Depois da caminhada estávamos com muita sede.
cards.ex_trans: After the hike we were very thirsty.

cards.note: sono is sleep itself; sonho is a dream
cards.ex_t: O café não ajudou, continuo com sono.
cards.ex_trans: The coffee didn't help, I'm still sleepy.

cards.note: ter medo de — to be afraid of
cards.ex_t: Tenho medo de alturas, as levadas custam-me.
cards.ex_trans: I'm afraid of heights, levadas are hard for me.

cards.ex_t: Desculpa, estou com pressa — falamos logo.
cards.ex_trans: Sorry, I'm in a hurry — we'll talk later.

cards.note: every old street in Funchal
cards.ex_t: A rua é estreita demais para o carro.
cards.ex_trans: The street is too narrow for the car.

cards.note: as a noun, o largo is a little square
cards.ex_t: O caminho fica mais largo depois do túnel.
cards.ex_trans: The path gets wider after the tunnel.

cards.ex_t: Leva só uma mochila leve.
cards.ex_trans: Take just a light backpack.

cards.ex_t: A mala está pesada demais para a cabine.
cards.ex_trans: The suitcase is too heavy for the cabin.

cards.note: suave for sounds and flavours
cards.ex_t: O bolo do caco fresco é macio por dentro.
cards.ex_trans: Fresh bolo do caco is soft inside.

cards.ex_t: Fora de época, o hotel está meio vazio.
cards.ex_trans: Off season, the hotel is half empty.

cards.note: invariable; gratuito is the formal twin
cards.ex_t: A entrada é grátis ao domingo.
cards.ex_trans: Entry is free on Sundays.

cards.note: em segunda mão also works
cards.ex_t: Comprei o carro usado, mas está impecável.
cards.ex_trans: I bought the car second-hand, but it's immaculate.

cards.note: café forte, chuva forte — heavy rain too
cards.ex_t: Hoje a ondulação está forte.
cards.ex_trans: The swell is strong today.

cards.note: rede fraca — weak signal
cards.ex_t: O sinal aqui é fraco.
cards.ex_trans: The signal here is weak.

cards.note: also the noun: um doce — a sweet/pastry
cards.ex_t: Este vinho é doce demais para mim.
cards.ex_trans: This wine is too sweet for me.

cards.note: os salgados — the savoury snacks at the counter
cards.ex_t: A sopa ficou um bocado salgada.
cards.ex_trans: The soup came out a bit salty.

cards.ex_t: No inverno fica escuro às seis.
cards.ex_trans: In winter it gets dark at six.

cards.note: devagar is the adverb: fala devagar
cards.ex_t: A internet aqui é lenta à noite.
cards.ex_trans: The internet here is slow at night.

cards.ex_t: Esse trilho é perigoso com chuva.
cards.ex_trans: That trail is dangerous in the rain.

cards.note: noun and adjective: é seguro / o seguro do carro
cards.ex_t: A zona é segura, mesmo à noite.
cards.ex_trans: The area is safe, even at night.

cards.note: claro! is the everyday 'of course'
cards.ex_t: — Podes ajudar? — Claro!
cards.ex_trans: — Can you help? — Of course!

cards.note: also the filler word: pronto, já está — right, done
cards.ex_t: O jantar está pronto!
cards.ex_trans: Dinner is ready!

cards.ex_t: Raramente chove no Porto Santo.
cards.ex_trans: It rarely rains on Porto Santo.

cards.note: frequentemente exists but this is what people say
cards.ex_t: Venho muitas vezes a este café.
cards.ex_trans: I come to this café often.

cards.ex_t: Às vezes trabalho a partir de um café.
cards.ex_trans: Sometimes I work from a café.

cards.note: the word you need most in week one
cards.ex_t: Pode falar mais devagar, se faz favor?
cards.ex_trans: Could you speak more slowly, please?

cards.ex_t: Anda depressa, o autocarro está a chegar!
cards.ex_trans: Come quickly, the bus is arriving!

cards.note: só is the spoken twin
cards.ex_t: Faltam apenas dois dias para as férias.
cards.ex_trans: Only two days left until the holidays.

cards.note: also an overcoat, but you'll meet the adverb
cards.ex_t: Gosto da ilha, sobretudo do norte.
cards.ex_trans: I like the island, especially the north.

cards.trans: as a matter of fact, by the way
cards.note: a very pt-PT discourse word — instant native points
cards.ex_t: Aliás, foi ele que me ensinou isso.
cards.ex_trans: As a matter of fact, it was he who taught me that.

cards.note: triggers the conjuntivo: talvez venha
cards.ex_t: Talvez vá ao mercado no sábado.
cards.ex_trans: Maybe I'll go to the market on Saturday.

cards.note: porquê? alone is the question 'why?'
cards.ex_t: Fico em casa porque está a chover.
cards.ex_trans: I'm staying home because it's raining.

cards.note: mais with i is 'more' — one letter, different word
cards.ex_t: Quero ir, mas não posso.
cards.ex_trans: I want to go, but I can't.

cards.ex_t: Ouço podcasts enquanto cozinho.
cards.ex_trans: I listen to podcasts while I cook.

cards.note: also the verb colher — to harvest
cards.ex_t: Falta uma colher para a sopa.
cards.ex_trans: We're missing a spoon for the soup.

cards.ex_t: Comes o bolo com garfo ou à mão?
cards.ex_trans: Do you eat the cake with a fork or by hand?

cards.ex_t: Esta faca não corta nada.
cards.ex_trans: This knife doesn't cut anything.

cards.note: prato do dia — the daily special
cards.ex_t: Qual é o prato do dia?
cards.ex_trans: What's today's special?

cards.note: um copo de água — the free one you may ask for
cards.ex_t: Pode trazer um copo de água?
cards.ex_trans: Could you bring a glass of water?

cards.ex_t: Levamos uma garrafa de vinho para o jantar.
cards.ex_trans: We're taking a bottle of wine to dinner.

cards.note: pôr o lixo lá fora — the nightly ritual
cards.ex_t: Não te esqueças de pôr o lixo lá fora.
cards.ex_trans: Don't forget to take the rubbish out.

cards.note: estender a roupa — to hang the washing
cards.ex_t: Vou estender a roupa enquanto há sol.
cards.ex_trans: I'll hang the washing while there's sun.

cards.note: pt-PT says prenda; presente is more formal
cards.ex_t: Ainda não comprei a prenda de anos dela.
cards.ex_trans: I still haven't bought her birthday present.

cards.note: as festas — the season of village festivals
cards.ex_t: Há festa na vila este fim de semana.
cards.ex_trans: There's a festival in town this weekend.

cards.note: viajar is the verb
cards.ex_t: A viagem de barco demora duas horas e meia.
cards.ex_trans: The boat trip takes two and a half hours.

cards.note: véspera de Natal — Christmas Eve
cards.ex_t: Na véspera do exame ninguém dorme bem.
cards.ex_trans: The night before the exam nobody sleeps well.

cards.ex_t: Os vizinhos fizeram barulho até às três.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbours made noise until three.

cards.note: cheirar bem/mal — to smell good/bad
cards.ex_t: Que bom cheiro a pão fresco!
cards.ex_trans: What a lovely smell of fresh bread!

cards.note: the thing you hunt for in every café
cards.ex_t: Há alguma tomada perto desta mesa?
cards.ex_trans: Is there a socket near this table?

cards.note: à sombra — in the shade, where locals sit
cards.ex_t: Vamos sentar-nos à sombra.
cards.ex_trans: Let's sit in the shade.

cards.note: passado agrees: o mês passado, o ano passado
cards.ex_t: Na semana passada choveu todos os dias.
cards.ex_trans: Last week it rained every day.

cards.note: tenho uma dúvida — the polite way to ask a question
cards.ex_t: Professora, tenho uma dúvida.
cards.ex_trans: Teacher, I have a question.

cards.ex_t: Obrigado pela ajuda com a mudança.
cards.ex_trans: Thanks for the help with the move.

cards.note: ganhar a vida — to earn a living
cards.ex_t: A vida na ilha é mais calma.
cards.ex_trans: Life on the island is calmer.
